body:
I recently purchased 500mgs of MDPV off of a research chemical vendor on the internet. I was very excited to note that this is the fabled and somewhat rare tan MDPV, as opposed to the very negatively reviewed white MDPV.  It was abso-fucking-lutely cheap.
Tan MDPV is very euphoric, longer lasting, no compulsive redosing desire whatsoever
.
I recently got into photography, when I found out that my mom had an old thousand dollar Nikon N80 lying around the house that she never told me about (because its a film camera, and she thought it wasnt hip enough for me to want to use it, haha).  So I decided that it would be an excellent idea to use taking some pictures around the neighbourhood as a good excuse to go on 4 hour wandering trips throughout my city, absolutely wrecked and high off my rocker on MDPV.  I live for those wandering trips.  Ill bring my camera, warm clothes cause its cold as hell here in late November, and a backpack filled with film, Arizona iced teas, cigars (on a side note, cigars are unbelievable on stimulants), and other essentials, and go wandering throughout old factory buildings, freeways in huge meadows, downtown, under bridges, railroad stations, wherever the whims of the drug wishes me to go and I gladly follow, enthusiastic, bright eyed, and with camera in hand.
Ill leave at 6 and get back at 11 or 12, and because of the excellent quality of my vendors supply, Ill only have to redose once or twice throughout the whole trip and still maintain a healthy, speedy, but with no anxiety or pesky stimulant side effects, high. I take no more than 25mgs insufflation at a time, and no less than 15 (to get the full effect of the drug).  On a side note, Im speeding balls on said drug while writing this right now.
In short, I love this drug.  It sends my creativity through the roof and is generally 100% enjoyable and friendly.  The only downside is that I blow through three times as much film on it (and three times as much money!) because I absolutely have to! take a picture of absolutely everything!!  Because the world is beautiful on this drug, and because I can.
